title: Joining an Online Class
paragraphs: Curious about digital marketing, Sarah signs up for her very first online class, feeling slightly unsure about how a purely virtual classroom would actually work in practice.
During the first live session, her internet connection drops twice, and she misses parts of the introduction, feeling frustrated that her very first class experience began so awkwardly.
By the third session, she learns to join a few minutes early and mute her microphone when not speaking, small adjustments that make the sessions feel noticeably smoother than before.
By the end of the course, Sarah feels comfortable enough with the format that she signs up for a second course immediately, grateful that her early frustration did not stop her from continuing.
